Name: RocRail Client
Description: Plugin for OpenDeck that connects to RocRail and enables controlling your model train via Stream Deck

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.oled.Name: Rocrail OLED Button
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.oled.Tooltip: OLED button for loco list, functions, or speed display

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.accessory.Name: Rocrail Accessory
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.accessory.Tooltip: Control or watch one track-diagram element (turnout, signal, output/button, turntable; sensors/blocks/tracks status-only). Configure the item ID in the inspector.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speed.Name: Rocrail Speed Dial
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speed.Tooltip: Dial: rotate for speed, press to stop

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.stoploco.Name: Rocrail Stop loco
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.stoploco.Tooltip: Sets the current locomotive speed to zero. Requires a locomotive selected (throttle mode).

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedplus.Name: Rocrail Speed +5
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedplus.Tooltip: Increases the current locomotive speed by five steps (% or km/h depending on the loco). Requires a locomotive selected.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedminus.Name: Rocrail Speed −5
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedminus.Tooltip: Decreases the current locomotive speed by five steps (% or km/h depending on the loco). Requires a locomotive selected.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scroll.Name: Rocrail List Scroll Dial
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scroll.Tooltip: Encoder: scroll loco list or function list in throttle; same step mode as the global OLED/speed dial setting

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.back.Name: Rocrail Back
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.back.Tooltip: Return to loco list (stops current loco)

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrollup.Name: Rocrail Scroll Up
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrollup.Tooltip: Scroll up through loco or function list

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrolldown.Name: Rocrail Scroll Down
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrolldown.Tooltip: Scroll down through loco or function list

Localization.pi.title: Rocrail Loco Control
Localization.pi.hint.connection: Use the TCP control port (RCP, default 8051) – the same endpoint Rocview/OpenDecoder clients use.
Localization.pi.label.oledFontSize: OLED composite / labelled text font size (px)
Localization.pi.label.locoListDialScroll: Scroll when rotating OLED dial, speed dial (list mode), or list-scroll encoder
Localization.pi.option.locoListDialScroll.page: One page per step (same count as visible OLED buttons)
Localization.pi.hint.accessory: Controls or displays one track-diagram element of the Rocrail plan, independent of loco selection. Turnouts, signals and outputs/buttons flip on press; turntables step to the next track; sensors, blocks and tracks are status-only.
Localization.pi.label.accItemId: Item ID (as in the Rocrail plan)
Localization.pi.placeholder.accItemId: e.g. sw1, sg2, co3, fb4, bk01
Localization.pi.hint.oled: Rocview throttle view modes: applies only while controlling a locomotive. Each OLED key may show functions, loco portrait, or speed/direction independently.
Localization.pi.option.throttleView.loco: Loco portrait (name & image like list view)
Localization.pi.section.http: Loco images & function icons via HTTP
Localization.pi.hint.http: Rocview / Rocrail HTTP image service must expose files (Rocview Wiki: web service). Composites download from http://<TCP host above>:port/path/file.
Localization.pi.label.httpBasePath: HTTP base path for loco images (use / for root: http://host:port/<filename>)
Localization.pi.label.httpIconBasePath: HTTP base path for function icons (empty = use loco image base path)
Localization.pi.label.accessorySvgBasePath: HTTP base path for accessory SVG theme (empty = built-in symbols)
